arxiv-2110-02727.title: A compact formula for the quantum fluctuations of energy
arxiv-2110-02727.creator: Rajeev Singh
arxiv-2110-02727.description: Abstract A formula to calculate the quantum fluctuations of energy in small subsystems of a hot and relativistic gas is derived. We find an increase in fluctuations for subsystems of small sizes, but we agrees with the energy fluctuations in the canonical ensemble if the size is large enough.

arxiv-2201-07196.title: Reduced rank in σ ⁡ [ M ] \sigma[M] Thanks: The second author was supported by the grant “CONACYT-Estancias Posdoctorales 2do Año 2020 - 1”.
arxiv-2201-07196.creator: John A. Beachy, Mauricio Medina-Bárcenas
arxiv-2201-07196.description: Abstract . Using the concept of prime submodule introduced by Raggi et.al. we extend the notion of reduced rank to the module-theoretic context. We study the quotient category of σ ⁡ [ M ] \sigma[M] modulo the hereditary torsion theory cogenerated by the M M -injective hull of M M when M M is a semiprime Goldie module.

arxiv-2209-07079.title: Nonparametric inference for additive models estimated via simplified smooth backfitting Journal: Annals of the Institute of Statistical Mathematics Thanks: The online version of this article contains supplementary material.
arxiv-2209-07079.creator: Suneel Babu Chatla
arxiv-2209-07079.description: Abstract We investigate hypothesis testing in nonparametric additive models estimated using simplified smooth backfitting (Huang and Yu, Journal of Computational and Graphical Statistics, 28(2) , 386–400, 2019). Simplified smooth backfitting achieves oracle properties under regularity conditions and provides closed-form expressions of the estimators that are useful for deriving asymptotic properties.

arxiv-2311-12013.title: Weak existence for SDEs with singular drifts and fractional Brownian or Lévy noise beyond the subcritical regime
arxiv-2311-12013.creator: Oleg Butkovsky, Samuel Gallay
arxiv-2311-12013.description: Abstract We study a multidimensional stochastic differential equation with additive noise: d ​ X t = b ⁡ ( t , X t ) ​ d ​ t + d ​ ξ t , dX_{t}=b(t,X_{t})dt+d\xi_{t}, where the drift b b is integrable in space and time, and ξ \xi is either a fractional Brownian motion or an α \alpha -stable

arxiv-2401-12088.title: Unsupervised Learning of Graph from Recipes
arxiv-2401-12088.creator: Aïssatou Diallo, Antonis Bikakis, Luke Dickens, Rob Miller, Anthony Hunter
arxiv-2401-12088.description: Abstract Cooking recipes are one of the most readily available kinds of procedural text. They consist of natural language instructions that can be challenging to interpret. In this paper, we propose a model to identify relevant information from recipes and generate a graph to represent the sequence of actions in the recipe.

arxiv-2405-20654.title: Passage-specific Prompt Tuning for Passage Reranking in Question Answering with Large Language Models
arxiv-2405-20654.creator: Xuyang Wu, Zhiyuan Peng, Krishna Sravanthi Rajanala Sai, Hsin-Tai Wu, Yi Fang
arxiv-2405-20654.description: Abstract . Effective passage retrieval and reranking methods have been widely utilized to identify suitable candidates in open-domain question answering tasks, recent studies have resorted to LLMs for reranking the retrieved passages by the log-likelihood of the question conditioned on each passage.

arxiv-2502-11119.title: On an article published in the racsam
arxiv-2502-11119.creator: Nguyễn Sum
arxiv-2502-11119.description: Abstract . In this Note, we provide the comments on the paper [ 3 ] [ A note on the hit problem for the polynomial algebra in the case of odd primes and its application ] which was published in the RACSAM [Rev. Real. Acad. Cienc. Exactas. Fis. Nat. Ser. A-Mat. 118, 22 (2024)].

arxiv-2503-05173.title: Fair Clustering in the Sliding Window Model
arxiv-2503-05173.creator: Vincent Cohen-Addad, Shaofeng H.-C. Jiang, Qiaoyuan Yang, Yubo Zhang, Samson Zhou
arxiv-2503-05173.description: Abstract We study streaming algorithms for proportionally fair clustering, a notion originally suggested by [ CKLV17 ] , in the sliding window model. We show that although there exist efficient streaming algorithms in the insertion-only model, surprisingly no algorithm can achieve finite multiplicative ratio without violating the fairness constraint in the sliding window.

arxiv-2504-16765.title: Geometry of T1 transitions in epithelia
arxiv-2504-16765.creator: Pierre A. Haas
arxiv-2504-16765.description: Abstract The flows of tissues of epithelial cells often involve T1 transitions. These neighbour exchanges are irreversible rearrangements crossing an energy barrier. Here, by an exact geometric construction, I determine this energy barrier for general, isolated T1 transitions dominated by line tensions.

arxiv-2506-14457.title: Dataset Distillation for Memorized Data: Soft Labels can Leak Held-Out Teacher Knowledge
arxiv-2506-14457.creator: Freya Behrens, Lenka Zdeborová
arxiv-2506-14457.description: Abstract Dataset distillation aims to compress training data into fewer examples via a teacher, from which a student can learn effectively. While its success is often attributed to structure in the data, modern neural networks also memorize specific facts, but if and how such memorized information is can transferred in distillation settings remains less understood.

arxiv-2507-12209.title: Unveiling the galactic baryon cycle process by an empirical model Journal: APJ
arxiv-2507-12209.creator: Yaoxin Chen(陈瑶鑫), Xi Kang(康熙), Hong Guo(郭宏), Hou-Zun Chen(陈厚尊), Jiafeng Lu(卢家风)
arxiv-2507-12209.description: Abstract We propose an empirical model to describe and constrain the baryon cycle process during galaxy evolution. This model utilizes the evolution of star formation rate, derived from the stellar mass-halo mass relations (SHMRs) across different redshifts, and the cold gas content, derived from the NeutralUniverseMachine model, to constrain gas accretion and recycle of gas outflow in the model galaxy.

arxiv-2511-15810.title: Structure Formation with Dark Magnetohydrodynamics
arxiv-2511-15810.creator: Pierce Giffin, Andrew Liu, Jeremias Boucsein, Akaxia Cruz, Anirudh Prabhu, Stefano Profumo, M. Grant Roberts
arxiv-2511-15810.description: Abstract Long-range interactions in the dark sector can give rise to collective plasma phenomena that are capable of modifying the evolution of dark matter halos. We present the first study of gravitational collapse in a secluded dark U ​ ( 1 ) D U(1)_{D} model using a magnetohydrodynamic description of the dark matter.

arxiv-2601-03624.title: Architecting Agentic Communities using Design Patterns
arxiv-2601-03624.creator: Zoran Milosevic, Fethi Rabhi
arxiv-2601-03624.description: Abstract The rapid evolution of Large Language Models (LLM) and subsequent Agentic AI technologies requires systematic architectural guidance for building sophisticated, production-grade systems. This paper presents an approach for architecting such systems using design patterns derived from enterprise distributed systems standards, formal methods, and industry practice.

britannica-1911-patrocles.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-patrocles.description: Article 'Patrocles' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 20), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. When in command of the fleet of Seleucus (285) he undertook a voyage of exploration on the Caspian Sea to discover possible trade routes, especially for communication with the peoples of northern India. He came to the conclusion that the Caspian was a gulf or inlet, and that it was possible to enter it by sea from the Indian Ocean.

europmc-pmc4917669.description: Toll-like receptors (TLRs) are a family of pattern recognition receptors involved in cardiovascular diseases. Notably, numerous studies have demonstrated that TLR4 activates the expression of several of pro-inflammatory cytokine genes that play pivotal roles in myocardial...

pmc-10671527.title: Knockdown of Simulated-Solar-Radiation-Sensitive miR-205-5p Does Not Induce Progression of Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma In Vitro
pmc-10671527.creator: Marc Bender, I-Peng Chen, Stefan Henning, Sarah Degenhardt, Mouna Mhamdi-Ghodbani, Christin Starzonek, Beate Volkmer, Rüdiger Greinert, Valentina Salsi
pmc-10671527.description: Solar radiation is the main risk factor for cSCC development, yet it is unclear whether the progression of cSCC is promoted by solar radiation in the same way as initial tumorigenesis. Additionally, the role of miRNAs, which exert crucial functions in various tumors, needs to be further elucidated in the context of cSCC progression and connection to solar radiation.

pmc-11285132.title: Nutritional therapy for the prevention of post-intensive care syndrome
pmc-11285132.creator: Taku Oshima, Junji Hatakeyama
pmc-11285132.description: Post-intensive care syndrome (PICS) is a triad of physical, cognitive, and mental impairments that occur during or following the intensive care unit (ICU) stay, affecting the long-term prognosis of the patient and also the mental health of the patient’s family.

pmc-11534843.title: Chemosensory function of Varroa gnathosoma: transcriptomic and proteomic analyses
pmc-11534843.creator: Beatrice T Nganso, Nurit Eliash, Kannan Mani, Noa Sela, Alejandro Villar-Briones, Angelina Fathia Osabutey, Ada Rafaeli, Alexander S Mikheyev, Victoria Soroker
pmc-11534843.description: In this study, we evaluated the role of the gnathosoma (mouthparts) in chemosensing of the most devastating honey bee parasite, Varroa destructor mite. Through transcriptomic analysis, we compared the expression of putative chemosensory genes between the body parts containing the main chemosensory organs (the forelegs), gnathosoma and the rest of the body devoid of these two body parts.

pmc-11679445.title: Analyzing Parental Involvement in Youth Basketball
pmc-11679445.creator: Maria V Lopes, Andreas Ihle, Élvio Rúbio Gouveia, Adilson Marques, Cíntia França, Adam Baxter-Jones
pmc-11679445.description: Parental involvement in youth sports is increasingly relevant in scientific research since parents have gradually developed awareness regarding youngsters’ sports experiences. This study aimed to (1) examine potential differences in athletes’ and parents’ perceptions of parental involvement practices in youth basketball, (2) verify whether these perceptions differ by sex, and (3) analyze the relationship between the different perceptions dimensions recorded.

pmc-11705607.title: Recomendaciones preventivas vasculares. Actualización PAPPS 2024
pmc-11705607.creator: Domingo Orozco-Beltrán, Carlos Brotons-Cuixart, José R. Banegas, Vicente F. Gil-Guillen, Ana M. Cebrián-Cuenca, Enrique Martín-Rioboó, Ariana Jordá-Baldó, Johanna Vicuña, Jorge Navarro-Pérez
pmc-11705607.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Se presentan las recomendaciones del Programa de Actividades Preventivas y Promoción de la Salud (PAPPS) de la Sociedad Española de Medicina de Familia y Comunitaria (semFYC), para la prevención de las enfermedades vasculares (EV). Como novedad en esta edición se incluyen nuevos apartados como obesidad, enfermedad renal crónica (ERC) y esteatosis hepática metabólica; además de un apartado «No hacer» en las diferentes patologías tratadas.

pmc-11862616.title: Multifactorial etiology of manic episodes. About a case
pmc-11862616.creator: M. Valverde Barea, F. Vílchez Español, L. Soldado Rodríguez, M. O. Solis Correa
pmc-11862616.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionManic episodes have a multifactorial etiology, with frequent association with genetic factors, comorbidities such as systemic diseases or secondary to infectious diseases, and environmental exposure factors. The prevalence of bipolar disorder is markedly higher in patients with autoimmune disease. The risk of developing bipolar disorder in some studies has been seen to be higher among patients with rheumatoid arthritis, therefore chronic inflammation would be a potential mechanism and could be a modifiable risk factor for bipolar disorder.

pmc-12591500.title: Parametric portfolio policy with momentum-based sentiment trading strategy
pmc-12591500.creator: Wen-Yi Lee, Yu-Hsuan Lin, Jing-Rung Yu, Donald Lien, Jae Wook Song, Jae Wook Song, Jae Wook Song
pmc-12591500.description: To enhance the effectiveness of the conventional mean-variance portfolio model, this study introduces a parametric portfolio policy that incorporates a momentum-based sentiment characteristic vector. This vector enables the identification of outperforming assets by capturing both historical returns and market sentiment.

pmc-13096176.title: Interference-aware frequency-agile onboard processor using fine-grained multilevel analysis–synthesis filter-bank channelization
pmc-13096176.creator: Surajit Sarkar, Amitabha Das, Deepak Mishra, Amitava Gupta
pmc-13096176.description: This paper proposes a spectrally optimized, multichannel filter-bank channelizer with time-multiplexed hardware reuse and block-based per-sample FFT complexity based on a unified framework for deep-space and satellite-onboard digital signal processing. This framework achieves fine-grained channelization using a single prototype filter with substantially reduced memory and computational overhead.

pmc-13126451.title: Investigating video consultations as a new form of care for neuropalliative patients in specialized outpatient care: results from the project TANNE (telemedical answers to neurological inquires in real time)
pmc-13126451.creator: Christiane Weck, Stefan Lorenzl, Kirsten Brukamp, Viacheslav Galchenko, Tizian Juschkat, Christian Maier, Sebastian Müller, Jan Reichmann, Felix Tirschmann, Jürgen Zerth, Daniela Adolf
pmc-13126451.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundCurrently, there is no standardized care for neuropalliative outpatients in Germany. Those who require specialized palliative care often receive it from a Specialized Outpatient Palliative Care (SOPC) team or hospice, but without regularly access to neurological expertise. The TANNE project elaborated hints for a cost-effective telemedical link between neuropalliative expertise (a Neuropalliative Telemedicine Center) and existing comprehensive palliative care structures such as SOPC team and hospice. Video consultations enable a joint assessment of symptoms and targeted therapy.
